decisions.title: Scope: scanSources filters by loadMapIgnore at collection; ignored paths enter no universe
decisions.rationale: 9 consumers share one filtered universe; sandbox U/P: dup 1->0 gate red->green; src->vendored degrades to externals; post-filter reopens the divergence behind this bug

dig.command: sandbox U/P scan comparison + issue search repo:chenw521/GOS vendored OR closure + globMatch probe
dig.output_excerpt: U: files=3 edges=1 dup=[mxActor]; P: files=1 externals=1 dup=[]; glob: public/**=true public=false

decisions.title: Polluted peaks: gate advisory attributes missing fns via peak.owners x map-ignore; full coverage guides baseline reset
decisions.rationale: peak.owners already exists (engine.cjs:515 write, gate.cjs:1158 read); sandbox attribution 2/2 covered; auto-reset would bypass reason-match/single-consumption/archive audit chain

dig.command: sandbox peak.owners attribution probe + gate.cjs/map/index.cjs reset-chain read
dig.output_excerpt: peak.owners maps mxActor/mxShape -> public/drawio/js/embed.dev.js; attribution all-covered=true; reset chain: reason match + single consumption + edge-history.ndjson archive

decisions.title: Script exclusion: scan materializes map-ignored.txt (unmapped-fns twin, untracked+provenance); scripts grep -vxFf
decisions.rationale: glob single-point in scan; census layer: tracked trio are non-regenerable truths, map-ignored is regenerable byproduct; audit anchor is tracked map-ignore; avoids vendored-upgrade churn

dig.command: census.json entries for .gos/codebase/* + git ls-files cross-check
dig.output_excerpt: network/allowlist/edge-baseline git:true (non-regenerable); unmapped-fns git:false note=regenerable+provenance; map-ignored belongs to the latter layer

decisions.title: Discoverability: fix hints name map-ignore; scan prints excluded count; README en+zh gains glob-semantics section
decisions.rationale: reporter found the mechanism only by reading source — zero discoverability is a root cause of this bug family; fix-hint loop and rename-vendored hints are both dead ends named in the issue

dig.output_excerpt: README has no map section (only changelog line 312); map help mentions no ignore; parse-failures fix=run map scan (loop); dup-fn fix=rename the fn
